subject.title: feat(model): support one-turn chat model override

question: Should one-turn model overrides be accepted as inline slash syntax, a strict `chat.send.model` field, or a `sessions.patch` next-turn scope?
rationale: The current patch chooses inline gateway parsing, but related maintainer-tracked work asks for an explicit public API contract and the choice affects command authorization, Gateway protocol compatibility, session state, and model reporting.

options.title: Define the canonical API first
options.body: Keep this PR open but pause merge until maintainers choose the public one-turn override contract and the branch is aligned to that contract.

options.title: Accept inline slash syntax
options.body: Allow `/model <provider/model> <message>` as the product surface, but require it to run through existing directive authorization and include the missing proof and reporting behavior before merge.

options.title: Move to explicit chat/session fields
options.body: Reject inline parsing for this PR and rework the feature around `chat.send.model` or `sessions.patch` next-turn scope with protocol/docs/test updates.

recommendation.title: Define the canonical API first
recommendation.body: Keep this PR open but pause merge until maintainers choose the public one-turn override contract and the branch is aligned to that contract.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest available history signal ties this area to prior model override, session patch, and model-selection boundary work.
